verdict.rationale: Claude's memory/chat-search feature lets it reference past conversations for context (claude-docs-2, claude-docs-21, claude-docs-45), and Projects let users set up persistent knowledge bases/instructions scoped to a workspace (claude-docs-16), but the pack contains no explicit documentation of a global 'custom instructions' or persona-shaping preference setting that persistently alters every response the way the story describes. Missing for 10: explicit custom-instructions/preferences UI documentation, evidence it applies across all chats (not just within a Project or via retrieved memory), and any independent confirmation it reliably shapes tone/behavior every time.
